g.text: Figure 6b | Held-out prediction saturates as LFADS dimensions are added

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: All three source regions share one performance scale; ribbons are fold SEM and every model is evaluated on complete held-out trials.

For each source area, curves show held-out residual-population prediction for both other-area targets and the same-area control. Open circles locate the median training-selected rank and black triangles mark the rank-38

model. PSTH removal, scaling, penalty selection and rank selection use training trials only. The regional LFADS archive predates these folds, so this is a downstream readout benchmark rather than prospective LFADS validation.
